R367 — retire the baseline phase-cache lease before decode
Date: 2026-10-13 (Asia/Tokyo)
Status: READ-ONLY SOURCE DESIGN. SourceLLVM phase build 60676 was active under Main. No source edit, build, test, import/AST/lint, GPU/profiler/process/service/reset query/action, Git operation, or cleanup was performed.

## Question and result

Can the current 144 baseline expert slots stay mapped for Prefill, then be unmapped along with the later 768 extras, with all 912 ranked experts remapped and copied from immutable Host-USM before decode?

Yes, as a source-level design, with an explicit full-table invalidation and checked quiescence before any base detach, followed by fresh base-plus-extra mapping and fill from ArenaExpertSource::phase_blob. The slot offsets, reservation base, host residency vector and device residency allocation can remain at their current addresses. The current owner has no operation for unmapping the baseline, and map_base refuses when the base already owns a physical handle while map_extras requires that handle. The caller also encodes 144 mapped slots as the invariant after each GEN. These must change together.

This is a replacement/lease policy, not demonstrated memory fit: before decode all 912 extents still need physical memory, and budget() still requires the 512 MiB free-memory guard. The design adds a second transfer/verification of the baseline 144 blobs per successful GEN. It could address a phase transition's transient allocation pattern, but it does not make a 16K all-912 working set fit when its physical bytes plus other allocations exceed available memory.

## Source evidence

Source W: /home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013, supplied base 410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2, active uncommitted phase source and unknown-map fail-stop correction. It is source-only and unverified. Main's latest supplied registry is /home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013/bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-quiet-copy-pair/report-registry-v185.json; supplied count 894 is a separate registry count.

- src/core/phase_cache_owner.cpp:63-130 allocates offsets, strides, filled/staged/published tables and one stable reservation for layers * (3 + extras_per_layer) slots. The first 3 slots/layer occupy extent 0; each extra layer has its own extent. All slot geometry is computed before native ownership. Unmapping and remapping physical extents need not change the virtual base, offsets, or capacity.
- map_base (:211-215) requires no baseline physical handle. map_extras (:217-241) explicitly requires a mapped base and maps every extra extent. mapped(slot) is based on its extent's confirmed physical and attached state (:242-249); device_slot returns null when poisoned or unmapped (:251). resident_slot is gated by readers_ready_ (:279-280).
- fill_checked marks readers unavailable, requires a mapped slot, writes from the supplied source, reads back to a host verification vector, and byte-compares before staging (:282-307). upload validates each nonnegative staged entry refers to a mapped, verified, correctly layered slot, runs the caller's device-table upload/drain, then copies staged to the stable published_ vector and makes readers ready (:310-327). Thus an all--1 table can be published while extents are still mapped; unmapping afterward needs a dedicated owner operation that leaves the all-miss table published.
- ExpertCache::open_phase reserves, maps baseline, allocates the fixed device residency table, and calls phase_publish (src/core/expert_cache.cpp:174-190). generate.cpp then fills ranks 0-2 for each of 48 layers and checks 144 published residents (:4532-4557). The immutable input path ArenaExpertSource::phase_blob verifies the source pointer is within an owned host range (src/core/expert_source.cpp:2700-2705); initial admission currently prevalidates the top 19 per layer (generate.cpp:4190-4196).
- Prefill reads host_res to skip resident experts and obtains device pointers only for entries whose table index is nonnegative (src/prefill/prefill.cpp references from rg: lines 1421, 1946-2010, 2142, 2168, 2311-2328, 2514-2525, 2572, 2597-2614, 2797, 2842). With all -1, those branches become cache misses and do not call device_slot; source-based fallback/staging remains active. This changes Prefill's work and timing. The source review found no unconditional direct read of a baseline slot once the corresponding host residency value is -1.
- Verifier::retire_phase_graphs (src/core/verify.cpp:156-169) requires readable hit state, checked commit, compute/copy stream sync, then destroys captured execs. generate.cpp's actual quiesce callback checks session identity and no adaptive/pending producers, commits verifier work, and device-syncs (:7991-8001). Its retirement callback uses retire_phase_graphs (:8002). Therefore the ordering needed is: publish all misses and refresh the device table; quiesce; retire verifier graphs and all other readers/producers; drain; then unmap. Destroying graphs alone does not prove every reader retired.
- Current cycle wiring (generate.cpp:8024-8065) maps extras after workspace retirement and checks 912 mapped/resident. Before the next GEN it invalidates extras, refreshes the device table, unmaps extras and checks 144 mapped. begin_gen (:8481-8485) expects 144 or 912 according to workspace state. PhaseServeCycle (include/strata/core/phase_serve_cycle.hpp) calls quiesce, graph retirement, invalidation/detach, then workspace reinit before a subsequent GEN; successful prompt calls quiesce, retires Prefill, then grows/fills/publishes. The normal QUIT path in generate.cpp:10636-10658 quiesces, resets Prefill if needed, retires verifier/session graphs and clears drive pointers before checked close.

The unknown-map fail-stop correction already present is material. map_extent marks maybe_attached before attach. detach_extent refuses to unmap a possibly attached but not confirmed mapped range; failed attach stops extra rollback, and close globally rejects cleanup if any physical extent has unknown mapping state (phase_cache_owner.cpp:145-208,356-380). A new baseline/all-extents detach path must use the same checked detach logic and stop immediately on uncertain attach/detach. Do not recover by retrying unmap or by freeing the SYCL reservation after uncertainty.

## Smallest implementation shape

1. Keep reserve geometry, physical ownership model, address layout, source format and fill/readback checks unchanged. Add an owner operation to invalidate all resident slots through the existing checked Publish callback, not only extras. It must set readers_ready_ = false, stage all -1, successfully upload/read back/compare the complete device residency table, drain, then publish the host all-miss table.
2. Add a checked unmap_all/unmap_base operation that requires the all-miss published state, invokes caller quiescence, drains, detaches extras in reverse order and then the base via existing detach_extent, clears filled_ only after each confirmed detached extent, and leaves the owner/reservation/tables intact. readers_ready_ can be true only after the verified all-miss state is established. Any unknown or failed detach poisons and retains all uncertain owners; do not continue to later extents.
3. Add an explicit remap-and-refill transition: map_base, then map_extras, then loop all 19 ranks/layer using only the prevalidated phase_blob Host-USM pointers and existing checked fill. Publish once after all 912 copied/verified slots are staged, refresh external drive/Verifier pointers as required, and assert 912 mapping/resident counts. Preserve the same base, offsets pointer, host table pointer, device table allocation, and d_res address.
4. Wire first successful GEN and later GEN separately. A low-risk placement is after Prefill::reset and graph retirement in the existing successful-prompt boundary: invalidate all, detach every extent, then remap/fill/publish all 912 before decode. This does not change Prefill arithmetic, quantization or chunk choice. If the actual proposal is to unmap baseline before or during Prefill, it also needs a pre-Prefill all-miss publication and quiesced base unmap, followed by host-only/stager fallback through the entire prompt; that is a different and larger change. No such early transition is implied by the current callback order.
5. Change the next-GEN and QUIT invariants: after successful decode, invalidate all (or at minimum all residents that are about to be unmapped), refresh, quiesce/retire graphs, unmap all, then reinitialize Prefill with a zero-mapped owner. On subsequent successful prompt repeat remap/fill/publish 912. QUIT must tolerate zero mappings or 912 mappings, retire readers before close, and close the reserved address exactly once. If a GEN is cancelled/nonfinite, current cycle policy rejects further GEN and ends in fail-stop/QUIT handling; it must not start a remap or cleanup retry from an uncertain native state.
6. Keep map_base/map_extras capability and fresh-free/512 MiB admission gates. The all-912 physical demand is unchanged; capacity/mapped-byte assertions and telemetry must distinguish reservation, mapped physical bytes, and resident payload. Do not change first-use GDN chooser or GEMM workspace owner/512 MiB guard as part of this source design.

Possible alternative: to make cache miss throughout Prefill, call publish-all-misses + graph retirement/quiesce + unmap before entering Prefill, then only remap/fill after successful prompt. This removes all 144 mappings during Prefill, but changes Prefill's cache/stager route. Source suggests all cache hit checks are host-residency-gated, yet the existing native dequant-batch/stager path and every no-cache fallback would require focused caller audit before considering it. No code presently performs this all-miss transition.

## Required serialized checks and probes

No test/build was run here. After Main's active phase build and measurement window closes, the smallest useful owner test is a CPU mock case that begins with baseline+extras published, verifies publish-all-misses makes both host/device tables all -1, verifies detach order and slot clearing, and confirms the same reservation, offsets pointer and table pointers survive. A subsequent map/fill/readback/publish should restore the identical 912 expert-to-slot mapping. Fault cases must cover base detach failure, each extra detach failure, map failure at base and each extra, fill/readback mismatch, residency upload/readback failure, and repeated close. For uncertain map/unmap failures assert no subsequent unmap retry, physical destroy or reservation release and no healthy readers. The existing fixture has multi-extent unknown-map subprocess coverage, baseline/extra fill tests, stable pointer checks and two-GEN ordering, but does not cover unmapping/remapping the baseline or all extents as a cycle.

Main's meaningful serialized runtime probe should first compare current and candidate across two fresh GENs in the same server: charge each first-use baseline recreation and full fill/readback; verify exact bytes/byte hashes and published table; verify one-token decode correctness/logits against the current path; record full wall and separate Prefill/decode timing; confirm next GEN begins with zero or documented mapped state; then QUIT with a checked owner close. Include cancellation/nonfinite handling as a terminal failure case, and inject or mock failure at every map/unmap boundary rather than trying GPU recovery after uncertain state. Qualification remains required for the installed SourceLLVM/UR path and the current actual binary; CPU fixture results alone do not qualify VMM.

First-use GDN chooser, GEMM workspace owner/512 MiB guard and whether the model's other allocations leave room for the all-912 cache remain independent constraints. No claim is made that a B570 10 GiB / 16K context will fit.

## Prior evidence and limits

Deduplicated against implementation-phase-cache-stock-bench-v4.txt, research-decode-cache-fill-amortization-round355-v1.txt, research-phase-vmm-real-api-lifetime-round360-v1.txt, research-vmm-map-failure-atomicity-round362-v1.txt, and implementation-phase-uncertain-mapping-failstop-v1.txt in /home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007/research-20261009. R360/R362 establish the need for capability-correct geometry and fail-stop uncertain mapping. R355 establishes that phase fill includes per-blob copy/readback/compare and must be charged per GEN. This report adds the all-resident invalidation/remap design and current source-reader audit.

No exact candidate blob sum, free-memory headroom, phase duration, provider error state, 16K fit, GDN chooser admission, or runtime outcome was measured. No arithmetic, quantization, chunking, or source was changed.
